show_title: Capital Allocators – Inside the Institutional Investment Industry
title: Florian Bartunek – Equities in Brazil at Constellation Asset Management (Manager Meetings, EP.27)
summary:
Greg is the Co-CIO and Head of Research for Fund
Evaluation Group, an institutional OCIO and investment consultant
with $83 billion in assets under advisement. Lastly, Florian discussed
opportunities and risks in Brazil, and his prediction for Brazil in
the next World Cup.
